title: Efforts Made to Return Unclaimed CPF Monies to Family Members
what_it_is: Efforts Made to Return Unclaimed CPF Monies to Family Members

sections.label: Unnominated CPF monies distribution
sections.summary: PTO contacts possible claimants, distributes unnominated CPF monies, holds $132 million unclaimed, and requires documentary proof for applications.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: PTO will contact individuals who are known to possibly have an interest in the deceased member's unnominated CPF monies and also invite them to make an application claim for these unnominated funds.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: These persons include (a) persons who approach CPF Board to inform CPF Board of the deceased's passing, (b) the death informant listed in the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority's (ICA's) records, and (c) the deceased's family members as reflected in ICA's records.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: PTO managed to distribute about 88% of the unnominated CPF monies it received from CPF Board over the last five years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: As at end of 2018, unclaimed unnominated CPF monies make up $132 million of the $211 million in unclaimed monies held by PTO.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: PTO continues to make efforts to locate legally entitled beneficiaries of unclaimed monies and they do so by making phone calls, writing to them on several occasions and also, in some cases, making house visits.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: We would like to encourage individuals who may be legally entitled to the monies to submit their application.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: There is no time limit for the application.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: To ensure that the monies are distributed to the rightful applicants, PTO requires that an applicant produce documentary proof to support his claim and also the eligibility entitlement.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: Where necessary, PTO will assist the applicant to obtain the necessary documents from the relevant agencies, by making a request on behalf of an applicant, or supporting his request for information.
